reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: The sink at line 22 constructs a redirect URL using user-supplied 'param'. Although a prefix check ('param.startsWith(allowed)') exists, it is insufficient to prevent open redirects (e.g., passing '//evil.com' after the allowed prefix). The resolved sink value depends on attacker-controlled input. Case TP.

evidence.note: User input 'param' flows directly into 'sendRedirect' despite a weak prefix validation check.
